baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction نجعل الأرض مهادًا assigns مهادًا as the state or configuration of الأرض.
baseline_models.mechanism: State-making configures the lower ground as a prepared child's cradle: a supporting environment is deliberately fitted to dependent occupants rather than merely brought into existence.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies the predicative change by which earth becomes a cradle-like arrangement.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the supported lower domain being configured.
A child's prepared cradle supplies fitted support and a relation of care toward a vulnerable occupant.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that the earth was made.
changed_reading.after: The verse points to the earth's having been purposefully configured as prepared, sustaining accommodation for dependent life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الأرض and مهادًا permit a material-spatial reading of the made state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A massive mat and a smoothed spread converge on a broad furnished plane: rough ground has been rendered traversable, restable, and usable.

activation_trace.role: State-transformation makes usability an achieved condition rather than an intrinsic label.
The thick mat gives the earth a large-scale furnishing image beneath the occupant.
Smoothed bedding supplies the leveled, spread quality that makes the ground usable.

changed_reading.before: Mihād is only a conventional synonym for earth.
changed_reading.after: Mihād foregrounds the earth as a deliberately furnished and smoothed human-scale surface.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The م ه د branch of preparing and smoothing a matter can govern how the earth's making is construed.
baseline_models.mechanism: Soft fertile ground is not simply a mattress-like object; it is a medium whose conditions have been put in order so that it can enable what depends on it.

activation_trace.role: Making something into being supplies deliberate production of the enabling medium.
Soft fertile ground supplies a receptive and productive material rather than a merely hard floor.
Preparing and smoothing a matter turns mihād into functional readiness, not only surface shape.

changed_reading.before: The image describes the earth's static flatness.
changed_reading.after: The image describes a receptive medium deliberately readied to support further processes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The smoothed horizontal mihād is paired with raised solid masses figured as driven pegs. Together they activate an engineered habitat in which accommodation at the surface is complemented by vertical anchoring.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies the broad horizontal furnishing whose relation to pegs can be tested.
Smoothed bedding supplies the accommodated surface in the paired construction.
A raised solid mass supplies the vertical and resistant element adjoining the spread earth.
The driven peg supplies the fastening image and lets the mountain act as an anchor in the model.

structural_cues: 78:7 is immediately coordinated to 78:6, pairing earth/mihād with mountains/pegs.
The paired predicates contrast a broad horizontal surface with raised solid fasteners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bedding, solid mountains, and driven pegs; I infer that the pegs anchor or stabilize the accommodated surface. A live alternative is that the peg image marks firmness or boundary without asserting a geophysical causal function.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a comfortable spread considered by itself.
changed_reading.after: The earth is the usable surface of an integrated construction whose softness is paired with anchoring solidity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated acts of state-making place the earth's mihād inside a daily care cycle: sleep stops activity, night covers, and day opens livelihood. The cradle becomes a temporal habitat that alternates recovery and exertion.

activation_trace.role: The prepared cradle supplies sustained care as the focus anchor for the temporal cycle.
Repeated state-making links sleep to the same configuring agency used for the earth.
Sleep supplies bodily repose enacted upon the prepared habitat.
Cutting or removal makes rest a functional interruption of activity, not mere passivity.
Night and its darkness supply the recurring temporal chamber for concealment and rest.
Covering with clothing supplies protective enclosure around the resting occupant.
Livelihood supplies the active daytime phase that the resting phase enables.

structural_cues: 78:9-11 repeat جعلنا in parallel clauses soon after نجعل in 78:6.
Sleep/rest, night/covering, and day/livelihood form an alternating sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated making, cessation, covering, and livelihood; I infer a coordinated recovery-work cycle supported by the mihād. The alternative is a list of independent signs whose parallel grammar need not imply one system.

changed_reading.before: The cradle image concerns spatial comfort alone.
changed_reading.after: The earth is one component of a timed habitat that repeatedly protects, restores, and releases its occupants into livelihood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prepared earth becomes the receptive middle of a vertical production chain: a structure is built above, water is delivered downward, and concealed seed and vegetation are brought outward. Mihād thus names a working seedbed, not an inert floor.

activation_trace.role: Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive layer that can convert inputs into growth.
Preparing and smoothing a matter supplies functional readiness for the production chain.
Building by joining parts supplies an organized upper structure rather than empty space.
Spatial height places that built structure above the receptive earth.
Delivering something downward supplies the directional transfer from above.
Water conveyed by pouring or irrigation supplies the productive input received below.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the output direction from hidden ground to visibility.
The seed that sprouts and bears grain supplies the stored productive unit within the medium.
Vegetation emerging from the earth confirms the receptive layer's visible yield.

structural_cues: 78:12 locates a built structure above the addressees, while 78:14 marks downward delivery.
The purpose construction in 78:15 explicitly links the water to bringing out grain and vegetation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upper construction, descending water, and a purpose-marked emergence of seed and plants; I infer that the focus earth is the receiving and transforming interface. The live alternative is that the earth remains an unstated background rather than the emphasized causal medium.

changed_reading.before: The prepared earth passively bears its occupants.
changed_reading.after: The prepared earth actively receives descending provision and mediates its conversion into food and growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's mat and bedding join a covering night, a built overhead, a lamp, and a sky that can open as entrances. These material roles activate a furnished cosmic interior whose floor is the mihād.

activation_trace.role: The thick mat supplies the floor furnishing of the proposed interior.
Smoothed bedding makes the floor habitable rather than merely structural.
Night's darkness supplies the enveloping condition around the furnished floor.
A clothing-cover supplies a textile-like enclosure around the interior.
Construction by joined parts supplies the architectural action above the floor.
The upper direction positions the construction as an overhead.
The luminous lamp supplies an interior light-source within the architectural analogy.
Opening a closure supplies the later breach of the overhead boundary.
The sky as what rises and shades supplies the roof-like upper domain that opens.
An entrance supplies the doorway image and completes the interior's access points.

structural_cues: The furnishing terms occur before explicit building, lamp, opening, and door terms in the same surah.
The earth is below while the constructed and later opened domain is repeatedly located above.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mat, bedding, cover, overhead construction, lamp, and doors; I assemble their material roles into one cosmic interior. They may instead be locally independent comparisons, so the architectural unity remains medium-confidence.

changed_reading.before: Earth as bed is an isolated comparison.
changed_reading.after: Earth as mihād functions as the furnished floor of a larger inhabited construction with cover, overhead, light, and entrances.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Day of Separation is followed by removal of the very mountains earlier paired with the mihād, until their solid mass becomes mirage. The earth's prepared stability is therefore an administered state with a terminus, not an indestructible ontology.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state allows mihād to be a configured condition rather than an immutable essence.
Preparation supplies the ordered condition that can later be withdrawn.
Separation that exposes a boundary supplies the temporal break in the created order.
Removal and displacement supply the undoing of the anchoring landscape.
The same raised solid masses paired with the focus become the object of removal.
A mirage gleaming like water supplies the terminal loss of apparent solidity.

structural_cues: Mountains first occur beside the earth as pegs in 78:7 and recur as moved mirage in 78:20.
78:17 marks the pivot from the creation sequence to the appointed Day of Separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed separation, displacement, and solid mountains becoming mirage; I infer that this reverses the earlier habitat's stabilizing arrangement. An alternative treats the later event as an exceptional scene that does not qualify the ordinary force of mihād.

changed_reading.before: The earth's bed-like stability appears permanent and self-subsisting.
changed_reading.after: The earth's stability is a deliberately maintained, time-bounded arrangement that its maker can dismantle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact recompense and exhaustive binding record turn the prepared habitat into an accountable field of action. Accommodation enables agency, but action within it is measured and returned rather than absorbed by the comfort of the setting.

activation_trace.role: A matter made ready supplies the enabled arena in which subsequent action can occur.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the return path from conduct to consequence.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart supplies proportionality in that return.
Counting by exhaustive enumeration supplies complete capture of what occurs in the arena.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies durable, binding record.

structural_cues: 78:29 extends enumeration to every thing and renders it as a record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportional recompense and exhaustive record; I infer that the prepared earth is the arena whose enabled actions enter that record. The live alternative is that the judgment section concerns persons without retrospectively changing mihād.

changed_reading.before: The prepared earth is an unconditional comfort supplied to passive occupants.
changed_reading.after: The prepared earth is enabling accommodation for responsible occupants whose use of it yields exactly recorded consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The child's cradle and the prior favor branch of mihād are sharpened by lordship as nurturing completion, gift, and sufficiency. Earth-making reads as an early act in a longer economy of care rather than a bare feat of power.

activation_trace.role: The prepared child's cradle supplies the initial image of dependent care.
A prior hand of favor supplies benefaction already advanced in the earth's preparation.
Repairing, nurturing, and bringing to completion supplies an extended process of care.
Handing over and giving supplies the explicit gift relation that sharpens mihād as favor.
Sufficiency and enrichment supply adequacy or abundance to the gift.

structural_cues: 78:36 names recompense as a gift from your Lord.
The same surah moves from prepared earthly support to a concluding grant described through رب, عطاء, and حساب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cradle, prior favor, nurturing completion, gift, and sufficiency; I infer a continuum in which earth-making is an antecedent act of care. حساب can alternatively activate counting rather than sufficiency, and the later gift need not define the earlier creation sign.

changed_reading.before: The earth-cradle demonstrates power through a completed past arrangement.
changed_reading.after: The earth-cradle is also an antecedent gift within continuing lordly nurture and completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the surah's end a person sees what his hands advanced and the disbeliever wishes to be dust. The accommodating ground of 78:6 becomes the material condition into which an exposed human wishes to collapse, reversing supported occupancy into relinquished personhood.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground supplies the original material support beneath the addressee.
The prepared cradle supplies the initial relation in which a person is sustained above the ground.
Directing sight or insight to perceive supplies the moment of unavoidable exposure.
Advancing something forward supplies the prior actions now placed before their doer.
What the two hands earned supplies personal agency and ownership of those actions.
Dust, earth, and soil supply the wished-for terminal material state.

structural_cues: The surah opens its creation demonstration with earth in 78:6 and closes with a wish to be dust in 78:40.
The final wish follows immediately upon seeing what one's own hands advanced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supportive earth, exposure to one's deeds, and a wish for dust; I infer a deliberate reversal from living upon the ground to wishing to become its material. The wish may instead be only escape from punishment, with no intended recall of the earlier mihād.

changed_reading.before: Earth as mihād is simply the place that supports human life.
changed_reading.after: Against the finale, that support is morally reversible: the exposed occupant can wish to surrender human standing and become the ground's dust.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant م ه د branch 'a prior hand of favor' and aligns it with later hand/advance language. It remains anchored in مهادًا and in exact عطاء, قدم, and يدي branches, but downstream prose should present it as an exploratory counterpoint rather than replace the ordinary cradle or bedding sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مهادًا can activate the inventory's prior-hand-of-favor branch while still retaining the earth as the object of نجعل.

activation_trace.role: A prior hand of benefaction casts the prepared earth as favor advanced before the addressees' response.
Giving by handing over confirms the benefaction side of the proposed contrast.
Advancing forward supplies the answering set of things that humans themselves sent ahead.
What the hands earned supplies human deeds set over against the prior favor.

changed_reading.before: The earth was physically prepared as a bed.
changed_reading.after: The earth's preparation can also echo a favor advanced to humans before the deeds their own hands advance for judgment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from the local senses of pairs, rainwater, gardens, and emergence into reproductive branches. It remains anchored in the focus's prepared child's cradle and fertile earth, and every cross-domain image is packet-backed; downstream prose should call it a gestational analogy, not claim that ماء in 78:14 lexically means semen or that جنات in 78:16 means fetuses.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The prepared child's cradle branch of مهادًا and the soft fertile الأرض support a nursery-scale analogy.

activation_trace.role: The prepared child's cradle supplies a nursery relation rather than generic flatness.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive body of the macro-nursery analogy.
A mate joined to its counterpart supplies paired generative organization.
Reproductive fluid in the womb supplies a deliberately analogical activation from the descending water.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from hidden development to visible life.
The fetus hidden in the womb supplies the contained developmental phase activated through the garden root.

changed_reading.before: Earth as cradle is a static comparison to infant furniture.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the whole sequence makes the earth-cradle a macro-nursery: paired life, receptive water, hidden formation, and emergence are coordinated around it.

strongest_changes: The adjacent mountain-pegs turn the soft mihād into the surface of an anchored construction.
The repeated making of sleep, night, and day turns spatial bedding into a cyclic recovery-and-livelihood habitat.
Upper building, descending water, and emerging plants turn prepared earth into a productive interface or seedbed.
The later displacement of mountains into mirage reveals the mihād as a maintained and reversible state.
The final wish for dust reverses the relation between a person sustained above earth and a person wishing to become its material.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package let one compact earth-bed image change scale repeatedly: engineering, daily rhythm, vertical ecology, domestic architecture, accountable agency, and eschatological reversal remained distinct mechanisms instead of collapsing into a single theme.
remaining_uncertainties: Mountain-pegs may signal firmness without licensing the inferred stabilization arrow.
The furnishing, roof, lamp, and door images may be independent comparisons rather than one cosmic interior.
حسابًا in 78:36 can reactivate counting instead of sufficiency.
The prior-favor/hand contrast and gestational nursery are branch-backed but intentionally form-distant analogies.
The final dust wish may not intentionally recall the earth-mihād at the opening of the creation sequence.
